source.commit_body:
Score-stage saturated dampener for decelerating call signals at 75+. Drifts
overall toward 72 when velocity_5d < 0; k=1 saturates immediately for any decel.

Per-trade evidence (10y v39 baseline, 30dte_opt @ w15):
- 75+ decel heavy (vel_5d ≤ -10): WR15=44.7% (below call BE 45%, EV-negative)
- 75+ accel heavy (vel_5d > +10): WR15=64.0% (z=+3.35)
- 19.3pp spread on 75+ cohort

H1 affected-tier passes: 1y+0.36 / 3y+0.51 / 5y+0.37 / 10y+0.36pp on 75+ TP%;
sign-consistent across all four windows. Worst spillover -0.03pp on 85+;
95+/90+ untouched. 175 displaced signals over 5y at WR15=51.4% (vs baseline 62.9%).

Two-stage calibration:
- Stage 1: 108-variant coarse grid on 5y (sweep.py) → g0_t65_a95_k3 (composite +0.274)
- Stage 2: 700-variant Bayesian-style local refinement on 10y (bayes_refine.py)
  → g0_t72_a80_k1 (composite +0.337, +0.063 over Stage 1)
- k=1 dominates k=3 by 0.13pp — empirical decel cohort underperforms uniformly
  regardless of magnitude, so saturated form fits the signal shape

Constants in scoring.py:
  SVD_GATE_SCORE = 75
  SVD_GATE_VEL   = 0
  SVD_TARGET     = 72
  SVD_ALPHA      = 0.80
  SVD_K          = 1

Apply order: AFTER PESS, BEFORE earnings boost (boost can't re-amplify
velocity-displaced peak; cohort lookup uses post-SVD score).

Wiring:
- database/utils/scoring.py: SVD constants + build_velocity_5d_map() helper +
  SVD logic block in compute_overall_score
- database/models/core.py: velocity_5d wired into calculate_scores_batched,
  recalculate_scores_batched, and single-row Score.calculate_overall_score
  (with version-id dedup since multiple versions can exist per (sym,date))
- simulator.py: velocity_5d wired into StockContext + bulk score load with dedup

weight_info exposes svd_dampen and svd_vel5d for explain-scores audits.

BSD null result also captured in experiments/breadth_score_dampener/ — breadth-
divergence cohort signal is real per-trade (-23pp opt vs gen WR at brd<=33)
but cumulative tier metric is too small to pass H1 alone (best +0.10pp on 75+).
F3F portfolio-stage retains the breadth role.

Closes Priority #12 (Score Velocity Cohort Discriminator).
